info.title: Estimate Tool API
info.description:
Live estimate-tool API: compute a priced
trip model, read the rate card, submit a reservation request. OpenAPI at
/estimate-api/openapi.json; Swagger UI at /estimate-api/docs.

post.description:
Exchange an Odoo login/password for a native API key (scope
'rpc') — the same credential the api-key header auth verifies, so a
login here feeds every authenticated route. Credentials are checked
by res.users.authenticate (native brute-force cooldown applies); the
key TTL comes from the endpoint's `estimate_login_key_ttl_days`
(0 = non-expiring).

post.description:
Start the native Odoo password-reset flow: if the address matches
exactly one account, a time-limited reset link is EMAILED to it
(auth_signup's /web/reset_password page) — the token never travels
through this API. The response is identical whether or not the
address is registered, so the route leaks no account existence.

post.description:
Log the caller out of Odoo by revoking the presented api-key —
the native res.users.apikeys row is deleted (base revoke(): matched
by the key's index, verified against the stored hash, ONLY that row
— the user's other keys survive), so the key authenticates nothing
from the next request on. There is no server-side session to end
beyond the key: under http_basic/public no key travels, so the
route answers ok with revoked=false and the client just discards
its credentials.

The authenticated caller's own profile — the identity behind the
api-key. SECURED (keeps the padlock): unlike login, it is idempotent
and mints no new key, so the app reuses the held key to rehydrate
identity on resume and to refresh `verified` after the front desk
approves — without re-logging in. Read-only: every field is edited in
Odoo at the front desk, there is no profile-update route.

AttachmentInfo.title: AttachmentInfo
AttachmentInfo.description:
One credential document filed on the partner — METADATA ONLY. The
bytes never travel through the profile route; downloading a document
is a separate, deliberate concern.

id.title: Id
id.description: Stable server handle (`db-<resource id>`) — the value to send as `guest.days[date].boatId`; the exact `name` is also accepted. Optional so a legacy name+cap payload still validates.

BoatName.title: BoatName
BoatName.description:
One live dive boat — id + name + capacity, never its cost
(R-068; boat COSTS ride the staff-only assumptions).

boats.title: Boats
boats.description: R-068's boat pool: material planning resources with capacity > 1, id + name + cap per boat, ordered by name. Send the id (or the exact name) as guest.days[date].boatId. Labels/caps only — boat costs never leave the staff role. Empty when the PMS capacity field is absent.

BoatsResponse.title: BoatsResponse
BoatsResponse.description:
The live dive-boat pool.

A read-only projection of the same helper the rates response rides
(boatNames) — served so an external consumer can offer the dive
planner's Boat dropdown without fetching a whole rate card.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: Staff-only rate overrides (deep-merged over defaults). IGNORED for any non-staff caller.

today.title: Today
today.description: Client date YYYY-MM-DD, trusted only within +/-2 days of server UTC (early-bird lead check); otherwise server UTC today.

retail_model.description: Present for staff and agent roles only.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.description: The merged rate assumptions. Staff only.

CustomItem.title: CustomItem
CustomItem.description: A free-form billed line the front desk resolves manually.

DayPlanEntry.title: DayPlanEntry
DayPlanEntry.description: One guest-day of the dive plan.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: One per-guest quote block per guest.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Each {'level': 'warn'|'crit', 'text': str}. Includes input-provenance notes: omitted check-in/check-out (priced on sample dates, 'crit'), an omitted dive window (derived from the guests' marked dive days, 'warn'), and marked dive days outside the dive window ('crit' — they earn no dive revenue).

covers.title: Covers
covers.description: Meal covers per date, keyed YYYY-MM-DD.

roomNames.title: Roomnames
roomNames.description: ALL live room resource names per room kind (e.g. {'standard': ['Standard A', ...]}), for the Room dropdown — the FULL pool, never pre-filtered by availability; clients fall back to 'Type #n' when absent.

roomAvailability.title: Roomavailability
roomAvailability.description: FREE room resource names per room kind for the trip window — the native planning-conflict read. None when the trip dates are unknown; a kind absent from the dict has no availability data.

EstimateModel.title: EstimateModel
EstimateModel.description:
The priced model (engine compute_estimate output). All keys are
Optional and extra keys are allowed so BOTH the full staff shape and
the role-filtered portal shape validate against the one schema.

source.title: Source
source.description: band | item | pricing | list_price | missing | derived.

FieldRate.title: FieldRate
FieldRate.description:
One patchable Pricing Setup figure, hard-locked to a product via
its SKU (internal_reference) + the pricelist band min_quantity.
`source` says which row backs it — a 'derived' figure
(per-pax division or a percentage card) is read-only and a PATCH is
refused.

FocRule.title: FocRule
FocRule.description:
The server 5+1 FOC rule (R-056): `per` paying guests earn one free
head (hotel_pms FOC_THRESHOLD - 1); `ok` mirrors the card's
foc_5plus1_ok flag. The client seeds and locks its 'Guests per FOC'
lever to this; the compute clamps it server-side regardless.

message.title: Message
message.description: Always the same message whether or not the address is registered — the reset link travels by email only.

roomId.title: Roomid
roomId.description: Links the guest to a Trip.rooms[].id.

transferDirection.description: Per-guest transfer leg where a group splits across both legs (overrides the trip-level default for this guest).

diet.title: Diet
diet.description: Free-form diet note; written to the guest's food_restriction (blank ones only) for the daily kitchen digest.

allergies.title: Allergies
allergies.description: Free-form allergy note; joined with diet into the guest's food_restriction for the kitchen digest.

name.title: Name
name.description: Optional tiebreak: only narrows an already-multiple phone match, never widens the search.

GuestLookupRequest.title: GuestLookupRequest
GuestLookupRequest.description:
Returning-guest lookup, phone-first. Phone travels in the BODY to
keep numbers out of server request logs (agent or staff only).

description.title: Description
description.description: The lead's free-text description: special requests plus the agent/instructor extras and total_guests/divers stored there rather than in typed columns.

InquiryDetail.title: InquiryDetail
InquiryDetail.description:
One inquiry lead in full (GET /v1/inquiry/{lead_id}), staff only.
Carries the structured InquiryRequest fields the lead stores in typed
columns, plus lead_id and created_at. The agent/instructor extras and
total_guests/divers that the inquiry write side records in the lead's
DESCRIPTION text (not typed columns) are returned verbatim in
`description` — parse them from there, not from missing columns.

InquiryListItem.title: InquiryListItem
InquiryListItem.description: One row of the staff inquiry list (GET /v1/inquiry).

company_website.title: Company Website
company_website.description: Honeypot — leave empty. A filled value is answered with a silent success and no lead.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Credential documents (pdf/jpeg/png), agent & instructor only — the server stores at most two.

InquiryRequest.title: InquiryRequest
InquiryRequest.description:
The /location "Send an Inquiry" form, SPA transport (one source
with the JSON-RPC /casa/booking/submit route — both delegate to the
website module's inquiry pipeline). Public route: the server
re-validates every field on its own and silently drops a malformed
entry — a bad answer never 500s and loses the enquiry (R-049).

lead_id.title: Lead Id
lead_id.description: The created lead, or null on a honeypot submission (silent success).

InquiryRoom.title: InquiryRoom
InquiryRoom.description:
One row of the Guest inquiry rooms repeater — a wish, not
inventory (stored as JSON text on the lead, D-5).

InquiryType.title: InquiryType
InquiryType.description:
The /location inquiry pill (crm.lead.casa_inquiry_type). Labels
read Guest / Travel Agent / Dive Instructor; the VALUES are the
historical ones on purpose so existing leads and filters keep
working (D-4).

Kpis.title: Kpis
Kpis.description:
Portal roles receive revenue/rpgn/discounts/guests/nights only;
cost, profit and margin are staff-only.

api_key.title: Api Key
api_key.description: A native Odoo API key (scope 'rpc') — send it as the api-key header on every authenticated route. Shown ONCE; it is hashed at rest and cannot be re-read.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Key expiry (UTC, ISO 8601), or null for a non-expiring key (endpoint TTL 0).

revoked.title: Revoked
revoked.description: True when the presented api-key was revoked server-side (it authenticates nothing from now on). False when the request carried no api-key header — http_basic and public sessions hold no server-side token, so there is nothing to revoke and 'logging out' is purely client-side.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: casa_website_role_verified — the front desk flips it to true after checking credentials. It is NOT is_agent (which drives commission); treat false as 'pending'. Guests are always false.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Credential documents filed on the partner during onboarding (agent/instructor) — metadata only.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
The authenticated caller's own profile — the identity behind the
api-key. READ-ONLY: every field is edited by the front desk in Odoo,
not through the API (there is no profile-update route). Fetch it any
time with the held key: the app rehydrates identity on resume and
refreshes `verified` after the desk approves, WITHOUT re-logging in
(a re-login would mint a new key).

PricelistInfo.title: PricelistInfo
PricelistInfo.description: One product.pricelist row for the staff Scenario dropdown.

default_id.title: Default Id
default_id.description: The walk-in Default card's id, or None.

PricelistsResponse.title: PricelistsResponse
PricelistsResponse.description:
The Scenario dropdown's card list — every product.pricelist,
staff-only. A non-staff caller is refused (403) before reaching this
shape.

RateManifestResponse.title: RateManifestResponse
RateManifestResponse.description:
The per-card rate manifest: the seed assumptions plus the field
addressing the staff Pricing Setup tab writes back through (staff
only).

RateUpdateRequest.title: RateUpdateRequest
RateUpdateRequest.description:
Write one edited Pricing Setup figure back into a pricelist card.
The server re-resolves the (pricelist, sku, min_qty) source and
refuses a 'derived' or unknown field; the figure is written
verbatim, never rounded.

roomNames.title: Roomnames
roomNames.description: ALL live room resource names per room kind, taken from the planning-role resources (front-desk renames tracked). The FULL pool — availability rides roomAvailability, never a filter on this list.

courseNames.title: Coursenames
courseNames.description: Live course display names per course key (dsd / refresher / ow / aow / rescue), taken from the matching product's name. Labels only; prices ride courseRates.

boatNames.title: Boatnames
boatNames.description: The live dive-boat pool (R-068: material planning resources with capacity > 1), id + name + cap per boat, for the dive planner's Boat dropdown. The id is what guest.days[date].boatId takes. Labels/caps only — boat costs never leave the staff role.

discounts.title: Discounts
discounts.description: Present (zeroed: agent=0, instructor=0) whenever the caller's role resolved a rate card — role cards are NET, the wholesale rate already carries the discount, so the percentage lever must not apply it a second time.

focOk.title: Focok
focOk.description: Whether the caller's SERVER role earns the 5+1 FOC (the role card's foc_5plus1_ok). Absent for staff. The compute clamps promos.foc.on to this regardless of the payload.

focPer.title: Focper
focPer.description: The server 5+1 rule's paying-guests-per-free-head (hotel_pms FOC_THRESHOLD - 1). The compute clamps promos.foc.per to this for every caller.

retailRates.title: Retailrates
retailRates.description: Agent/instructor only: the GUEST card's own full rates payload. The engine prices the Agent View's retail comparison off this, so 'retail' means what a guest would actually pay, not the caller's own card.

RatesResponse.title: RatesResponse
RatesResponse.description:
The live rate card merged into the engine defaults. Every block is
optional — the service returns what it can price and the engine falls
back to its defaults for the rest.

RegisterAttachment.title: RegisterAttachment
RegisterAttachment.description:
One credential document (agent/instructor onboarding). Validated
server-side by the website's existing attachment pipeline (mimetype
allowlist, magic bytes, 5MB cap) — a bad entry is silently dropped,
exactly like the /reserve/register form.

role.description: The onboarding role. agent/instructor file a front-desk verify To-Do; the role prices immediately, verification is a human step.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Credential documents (pdf/jpeg/png), agent & instructor only — ignored for a guest.

RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
RegisterRequest.description:
Open self-registration, mirroring the website's /reserve/register
onboarding: anyone registers as guest/agent/instructor; agent and
instructor accounts stay unverified until the front desk ticks the
verify To-Do their registration files.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: Always False at registration — agent/instructor credentials are verified by the front desk.

name.title: Name
name.description: Bound physical room resource name, e.g. 'Deluxe B'. Optional: an unbound room keeps positional 'Type #n' labels. Shape-checked only — an unknown name prices identically and the front desk resolves it at reservation.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description: ALL live room resource names per room kind — the full physical pool. A kind with no planning resources is absent.

available.title: Available
available.description: FREE room names per kind for the given window (native planning-conflict read). None when the window is missing, malformed or reversed.

RoomsResponse.title: RoomsResponse
RoomsResponse.description:
The live room pool + trip-window availability.

A read-only projection of the same helpers the compute response
rides — served so an external consumer can offer the Room dropdown
without pricing a scenario.

SubmitAttachment.title: SubmitAttachment
SubmitAttachment.description:
One per-diver certificate carried on the booking submit. Validated
server-side by the website's existing attachment pipeline (mimetype
allowlist, magic bytes, 5MB cap) — a bad or over-cap entry is silently
dropped so a malformed upload can never break the booking. Files land
on the folio, and where the guest_name matches a diver, also on their
res.partner.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.description: Per-diver certificates. Over-cap or malformed entries are dropped, never fatal.

TransferDirection.title: TransferDirection
TransferDirection.description:
Which leg a transfer serves. Label/routing only — the price is the
same either way; it rides through to the folio/van run so the desk
knows which end to book.

transferDirection.description: Default transfer leg (arrival/departure) for the trip; a guest may override it per-guest where a group splits.

diveFrom.title: Divefrom
diveFrom.description: Required (with diveTo) when any guest dives, unless the divers' own guest.days carry dive marks — then the window is derived from the marks.

diveTo.title: Diveto
diveTo.description: Required (with diveFrom) when any guest dives, unless the divers' own guest.days carry dive marks.

bookedDaysAhead.title: Bookeddaysahead
bookedDaysAhead.description: Lead time in days for the early-bird check.

Trip.title: Trip
Trip.description:
The tool's trip, sanitised server-side by engine.sanitize_trip
(unknown keys are dropped; exceeded caps raise -> HTTP 422).

WebsiteRole.title: WebsiteRole
WebsiteRole.description:
The onboarding role a self-registration carries (mirrors
res.partner.casa_website_role — NOT GuestType, whose 'retail' is a
pricing bucket, not an account role).

APIKeyHeader.description: The API key being logged out — the same header that authenticated this request in api_key mode.
APIKeyHeader.name: api-key

ApiKeyAuth.name: api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: An Odoo API key minted in Preferences -> Account Security (res.users.apikeys, scope 'rpc' — hashed at rest, expiration enforced).

tags.name: estimate
tags.description:
Price a trip scenario at live resort rates and, when ready, submit it as a
reservation request (folio + draft quotations). The scenario passes the
engine trust boundary (sanitize_trip) server-side; responses are filtered
by the caller's role — cost/margin/ops figures never leave the server for
a non-staff caller.
